How do I install the app on PC?

You need to download BlueStacks from the Microsoft Store on your PC or directly from the internet. Once it’s installed, open the Play Store in BlueStacks, search for SalesB in the search bar, and then download the app. That’s it—you can start using it right away.
How do I permanently delete my account?

You can request the deletion of your account by sending us an email at salesb@groupec.net with the subject line: Account deletion request. We will then send you a reply email with a few security verification requests. Once your identity has been confirmed, your account will be deleted within two weeks.
